title: XP progression feedback
prompt: Show a usable XP progression panel with a Gain XP control, a level, numeric progress and a bar. The loop starts at Level 1 with 80 of 100 XP. Each activation grants 35 XP; reaching 100 advances a level and carries excess XP.
acceptance: The Gain XP control updates the level, numeric progress and bar together.
Crossing a level threshold carries excess XP.
The panel remains usable in the recorded native viewport.
evidenceInstructions: Preserve product UI in the evidence, including labels and the Gain XP control.
Ordered stills show states, not elapsed time or continuous interaction.
